newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Beirut leads Beirut bourse to close higher.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Beirut leads Beirut bourse to close higher.

text.p: Bank of Beirut made gains in an uneventful market on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
The BLOM general index increased 0.34 percent to 1107.62 and the LISPI climbed 0.19 percent to 96.48 while the LIBX rose 0.37 percent to 191.11.
Turnover fell to 100,572 from 237,687 for a value of $1,302,092 against $3,447,192.
BOB climbed to $5.6875 from $5.6250. Banque Audi and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce were both flat at $27.125 and $20.5 respectively.
Solidere A held steady at $12.8750 while B rose to $13.1250 from $13.
Ciments Libanais was steady at $1.2813. It was last traded on August 13.
There was no trade in the other listed industrial firms -- Eternit, Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic. -- Beirut editorial (9611) 745307 745308 602057 MG sh
